title: Alert inbox
ui: New/unread; source; severity; child filter; quiet hours
api: M4 notifications list and deduplicated event IDs
rule: Access per child; no precise GPS embedded in push
accept: Read/ack state persisted with verified actor and UTC.

title: Alert detail
ui: Source time; reason; data confidence; ACK; diagnostics
api: Alert event and authorized observation reference
rule: No 'emergency' if FCM was merely accepted

title: Reliability Center
ui: Last heartbeat vs last location vs last processed route
api: Signed device health, observation and worker timestamps
rule: Do not infer permissions from silent device
error: Network stale; OS killed; unknown battery
accept: No false live status and actionable distinct causes.

title: Map evidence legend
api: Quality codes and source timestamps in route result
rule: Parent can flag interpretation, not change raw GPS
accept: Accessible map colors and legend agree.

title: Travel day selector
ui: Date; timezone; day totals; trip leg cards; gaps
api: M3 trip list query with date+timezone window
rule: No inferred travel for missing time
